svg.title: Metropolis-Hastings chain sampling a posterior
svg.desc: A Markov chain starts in the tail of a correlated two-dimensional Gaussian posterior and random-walks into its high-density region. Accepted steps are drawn as solid red lines, rejected proposals flash as dashed grey lines, and every draw stacks a block onto the marginal histograms of theta one and theta two, which grow towards the true marginal curves.

g.text: each draw stacks onto its marginal
